$comment: Key art for the five promote.json entries, one key per promotion id. Every picture pairs one of Hagicode's predefined Agent Girls with the entry's theme: her look (hair, eyes, outfit, accessory) is copied from steam-metadata's agent-girls.json and kept whole, and her pose and props carry the theme. Rendered with the Codex image tool (img-gen --provider codex), which ignores the seed, so a re-roll is just sync --only <key> --force and the picture is judged by eye. Textless on purpose: the image model cannot be trusted to spell a product name or a URL, and the promotion copy is localized in ten languages, so the title, description and CTA stay in the page. The hue of each sub-site follows its existing banner (awesome blue, design purple, openspec green, omniroute amber); the Microsoft Store entry follows the watercolor storybook look of the Steam hero. The girl sits right of centre and the left third stays calm so copy can be overlaid.

usage.purpose: Banner key art for one promotion entry: one Agent Girl performing the entry's theme.
usage.surface: Image of a promote_content.json entry, shown on the Promoto showcase and in the HagiCode app promotion slot.
requirements: Exactly one predefined Agent Girl, face and signature accessory readable at thumbnail size, right of centre; calm left third.
No text, letters, logos or UI chrome.

shared.composition: Make a wide landscape banner. Frame her from the waist up, right of centre, large enough that her face, hair and signature accessory read at thumbnail size, with her hands showing the theme. Keep the left third calm, open and softly lit so copy can be overlaid. Keep the picture uncluttered with premium lighting. The picture is pure illustrated artwork, and every sign, screen and surface stays blank and clean.
shared.negative: worst quality, low quality, watermark, logo, text, letters, typography, signature, UI chrome, frame, letterbox, black bars, multiple girls, extra people, crowd, close-up, extra fingers
